pain: GitHub job webhook deliveries need durable immutable receipts and safe out-of-order reconciliation without mislabelling queued work as a completed CI Activity Event.
done_when: GitHub HMAC validation over original bytes, strict body limits, enabled reviewed Repository mapping, delivery UUID and explicit disabled-by-default flag gate admission.
Separate SQLite Durable Object stores sanitized immutable job evidence and receipts with atomic original receipt return on identical retry and Conflict on changed content under the same delivery ID.
Late queued reports do not regress completed state, contradictory terminal evidence returns Unknown, and capacity/reading limits fail closed.
An additive Cloudflare migration preserves existing object classes and does not activate production collection, public read routes, credentials or runner routing.
Real Worker tests verify unsigned input rejection, retries across restart, conflicting deliveries, disabled/unconfigured operation, immutability, no private job steps and safe error outcomes.
